[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 00:35  
[USER] User inquired about "circular knitting."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Circular knitting is a technique of knitting in a continuous spiral, using circular needles or double-pointed needles, rather than straight needles. This allows for the creation of seamless, tubular fabric for items such as hats, cuffs, and sleeves.  
[USER] User asked for the main specifications of a circular knitting machine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The main specifications of a circular knitting machine include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Gauge: the number of needles per inch of fabric width.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Needle type: cylindrical or tapered.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Diameter of cylinder and dial: determines the size of the garment being produced.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Feeder type: single or multiple feeders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Stitch dial and cam system: controls the knit and purl patterns.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Yarn tensioning system: used to control the tightness of the yarn.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Take-down system: used to remove the finished fabric from the machine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Drive system: the method by which the machine is powered, such as electric or air.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Control system: computerized or manual control of machine functions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Number of feeders and yarn carriers: affects the machine's capability to produce multi-color or multi-yarn fabrics.  
[USER] User asked what the products produced by circular knitting machines are called.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The products produced by circular knitting machines are called knitted fabrics or knitted garments, including items such as t-shirts, socks, hats, gloves, scarves, sweaters, and more.  
[USER] User inquired about the stitch dial and cam system.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The stitch dial and cam system in a circular knitting machine are components that control the knit and purl patterns in the fabric. The stitch dial determines the type of stitch produced, while the cam system controls the movement of the needles to produce the desired stitch pattern.  
[USER] User asked for the English translation of "طاقه پارچه."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Takhe Parche" in Persian translates to "Loom" in English.
